findings.text: PipelineCost.releases is written there and read by nothing in production: imas_codex/cli/map.py:630 prints result.cost.steps only, imas_codex/ids/progress.py:292-317 reads steps only, and the persisted figure is total_usd, so a silent re-point of typesafe/jev-1.14 produces no visible or durable record and the tracking the resume brief asked for (a new date that shows) cannot be observed anywhere outside the tests.

releases is keyed by cost step rather than per call, so decide_batch over many states (imas_codex/discovery/base/judgment.py:283) and any two models booked under one step collapse to the last value, so 'every decisions cost record' is not attained even in memory.

The openrouter-pricing entries for gpt-5.6-luna (:904), gpt-5.5 (:952) and gpt-5.4 (:963) remain, so the done-when's 'pyproject.toml references no OpenAI model older than the newest of its tier' is literally unmet; the brief's own removal rule (only entries referenced nowhere in imas_codex/ or tests/) and the manifest's outside_scope line together justify leaving them.

The base arm ran at revision 844d598fb, which already contains commit 737edff17 that introduces the release-tracking feature, so this two-arm run cannot show that the feature added no suite failures; base..after measures only 33331ed6f's test fix.

justifications.durability: tests/discovery/test_decisions_release_tracking.py:127 and :158 key on tracker.releases, so dropping judgment._book_cost's note_release call raises KeyError there, and tests/core/test_settings.py:609 asserts an empty stale list over the module constants and packaged route table rather than over the accessor.
justifications.evidence: gate-base.log and gate-after.log record 114 passed EXIT=0 on both arms at 6c73f17/8471b89, and gate-release-base.log/gate-release-after.log record 66/66 failure ids whose set difference is empty in both directions (verified), but the release arm's baseline is 844d598fb, which postdates the release-tracking commit 737edff17.
justifications.fit: The optional sink at imas_codex/discovery/base/llm.py:3584 keeps the two-value return and follows the module's existing docstring-per-argument idiom, and no changed path or symbol carries a plan, sprint or ticket identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/config/litellm_config.yaml:88-104 and imas_codex/settings.py:1971-2000 do carry the newest model of every OpenAI tier, but pyproject.toml:904, :952 and :963 still reference gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5.5 and gpt-5.4.
justifications.reuse: PipelineCost.note_release at imas_codex/ids/mapping.py:93 extends the accumulator the decisions path already books into, but the repository's durable cost-record owner (LLMCost with llm_model at imas_codex/standard_names/graph_store/graph_cost_and_claims.py:75, event at imas_codex/standard_names/budget.py:148) is not extended, so the served build is held in a second, unpersisted store.
justifications.scope_discipline: Every path in git diff --stat 6c73f17..0097269ac is inside the eleven declared write paths, and the Jev and release-tracking work was each instructed by a resume advice file in the run directory.

outside_scope: The run's own note of a truncated imas_codex/llm/prompts/sn/generate_name_system.md during a standard-names gate run is a test-side defect outside this diff; the file is restored to HEAD (799 lines) and no changed path in the diff touches it.
